title: AI FLuency and Foundations
description: This quiz covers the basics of AI fluency Framework and Foundations

questions.prompt: According to the AI Fluency Framework, what does AI Fluency mean?

options.text: Memorizing the best prompts for different AI tools
Becoming a technical expert in AI development
The ability to work with AI effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely

questions.prompt: The four core competencies in the AI Fluency Framework are known as "The 4 Ds." Which of the following lists all four correctly?

options.text: Data, Delegation, Discernment, Documentation
Design, Description, Development, Deployment
Direction, Description, Decision-making, Diligence
Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence

questions.prompt: Which competency focuses primarily on deciding what work should be done by AI versus what should be handled by humans?

options.text: Delegation
Discernment
Description
Diligence

questions.prompt: According to the framework, what is the primary focus of the Diligence competency?

options.text: Making AI work faster and more efficiently
Responsible AI use, transparency, and accountability
Writing better prompts for AI systems
Evaluating the quality of AI outputs

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes "Problem Awareness" within the Delegation competency?

options.text: Understanding which AI platform to use
Clearly defining your goals and understanding what work is needed before involving AI
Evaluating the quality of AI outputs
Knowing how to write effective prompts

questions.prompt: Which competency focuses on communicating clearly with AI systems about what you want, how you want it done, and how you want to interact?

options.text: Discernment
Delegation
Description
Diligence

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes "Product Description" within the Description competency?

options.text: Taking responsibility for AI-generated content accuracy
Clearly defining what you want the AI to create or provide
Evaluating whether AI outputs meet your requirements
Explaining which AI platform to use for a task

questions.prompt: Which competency involves critically evaluating AI outputs, processes, and behaviors to ensure quality and appropriateness?

options.text: Diligence
Description
Discernment
Delegation

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes "Process Discernment" within the Discernment competency?

options.text: Ensuring transparency about AI involvement in your work
Assessing whether the AI's reasoning process and problem solving approach is effective
Deciding which AI system to use for a task
Judging the final quality of AI-generated content

questions.prompt: Which of the following best describes "Transparency Diligence" within the Diligence competency?

options.text: Being open and honest about AI's role in your work with those who need to know
Choosing the most advanced AI system available
Ensuring AI outputs are technically accurate
Making AI work as fast as possible
